title: Subject-Verb Agreement 主谓一致
brain_first: 按原文查阅 Subject-Verb Agreement 主谓一致

blocks.text: 核心不是“离谓语最近的词”，而是找到真正主语。

rows: Each / every / either / neither (单独作主语)
The quality of the products is...
blocks.text:
Situation | Rule | Example
Singular subject | singular verb | The result shows...
Plural subject | plural verb | The results show...
A and B | usually plural | Tom and Mia are...
Each / every / either / neither (单独作主语) | usually singular | Each has a role.
One of + plural noun | verb agrees with one | One of the students is...
There be | agree with following real subject | There are two reasons.
插入介词短语 | ignore the phrase | The quality of the products is...

rows:
长主语：The number of students is increasing；A number of students are waiting。不要只看
students。
